pages.title: Supported files
pages.text: Upload MP3 or WAV audio.$(br2)Renaming another format to .mp3 or .wav does not convert it.$(br2)The server validates content and enforces its upload limit.

pages.title: Upload limits
pages.text: The default limit is 5 MiB; administrators can raise it to 100 MiB.$(br2)Server policy can disable uploads independently of remote streams.
